															HSSC CET Group C 2026: Exam Pattern

															Pattern of Examination

															
																
																Total Questions: 100 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs).
																
																
																Total Marks: 100 marks.
																
																
																Duration: 1 Hour and 45 Minutes.
																
																
																Medium & Mode: Compulsory, bilingual (English & Hindi) questions conducted via an offline, OMR-based written test.
																
															

															Minimum Qualifying Marks

															
																
																General Category: 50%.
																
																
																Reserved Category: 40% (applicable to both vertical and horizontal reservations).
																
															

															Marking Scheme & OMR Guidelines

															
																
																Answering Option: Candidates are given four answer choices for every question to fill in the corresponding circle on the OMR sheet.
																
																
																Incorrect Answers: There is no negative marking for choosing a wrong option.
																
																
																Un-attempted Questions:

																
																	
																	If a candidate decides not to attempt a question, they must fill the fifth circle/bubble on the OMR sheet.
																	
																	
																	Failure to fill the fifth bubble for an un-attempted question will result in a penalty deduction of minus one mark per question.
																	
																
																
															
															
														
														
															
															HSSC CET Group C 2026 : Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																
																Pay Scale:  Assistant Superintendent Jail:- FPL-6  ||  Warder:- FPL-2
																
																
																Selection Process:  Selection on the Basis of Written Exam, PET/ PST & Merrti List.
																
															
															
														
														
														
    
        
        📋 How to Apply For HSSC CET Group C Recruitment Advt 06/2026

        
            Visit the official website hssc.gov.in or direct application portal adv062026.hryssc.com.
            Read the detailed advertisement (Advt. No. 06/2026) carefully.
            Click on “Apply Online” and register / login using your CET Registration Number.
            Fill the online application form with all required details and select post preferences.
            Upload scanned photograph, signature, and necessary documents.
            Pay the application fee (if applicable) and submit the form.
            Take a printout of the final submitted application for future reference.
        

        Note: Application window is open from 24 June 2026 to 30 June 2026. No offline applications will be accepted. Always apply through the official website only.

															HSSC CET Group C 2026: Exam Pattern

															Pattern of Examination

															
																
																Total Questions: 100 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs).
																
																
																Total Marks: 100 marks.
																
																
																Duration: 1 Hour and 45 Minutes.
																
																
																Medium & Mode: Compulsory, bilingual (English & Hindi) questions conducted via an offline, OMR-based written test.
																
															

															Minimum Qualifying Marks

															
																
																General Category: 50%.
																
																
																Reserved Category: 40% (applicable to both vertical and horizontal reservations).
																
															

															Marking Scheme & OMR Guidelines

															
																
																Answering Option: Candidates are given four answer choices for every question to fill in the corresponding circle on the OMR sheet.
																
																
																Incorrect Answers: There is no negative marking for choosing a wrong option.
																
																
																Un-attempted Questions:

																
																	
																	If a candidate decides not to attempt a question, they must fill the fifth circle/bubble on the OMR sheet.
																	
																	
																	Failure to fill the fifth bubble for an un-attempted question will result in a penalty deduction of minus one mark per question.
																	
																
																
															
															
														
														
															
															HSSC CET Group C 2026 : Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																
																Pay Scale:  Assistant Superintendent Jail:- FPL-6  ||  Warder:- FPL-2
																
																
																Selection Process:  Selection on the Basis of Written Exam, PET/ PST & Merrti List.
																
															
															
														
														
														
    
        
        📋 How to Apply For HSSC CET Group C Recruitment Advt 06/2026

        
            Visit the official website hssc.gov.in or direct application portal adv062026.hryssc.com.

            Take a printout of the final submitted application for future reference.
        

        Note: Application window is open from 24 June 2026 to 30 June 2026. No offline applications will be accepted. Always apply through the official website only.

															HSSC CET Group C 2026: Exam Pattern

															Pattern of Examination

															
																
																Total Questions: 100 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs).
																
																
																Total Marks: 100 marks.
																
																
																Duration: 1 Hour and 45 Minutes.

															Minimum Qualifying Marks

																Reserved Category: 40% (applicable to both vertical and horizontal reservations).
																
															

															Marking Scheme & OMR Guidelines

															
																
																Answering Option: Candidates are given four answer choices for every question to fill in the corresponding circle on the OMR sheet.
																
																
																Incorrect Answers: There is no negative marking for choosing a wrong option.
																
																
																Un-attempted Questions:

																
																	
																	If a candidate decides not to attempt a question, they must fill the fifth circle/bubble on the OMR sheet.

																Pay Scale:  Assistant Superintendent Jail:- FPL-6  ||  Warder:- FPL-2
																
																
																Selection Process:  Selection on the Basis of Written Exam, PET/ PST & Merrti List.
